description:
This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice of the Government’s intent to issue a solicitation for the following requirement:

National Stock Number: 5450-01-353-5769

Item: Paneling Material, Building

Quantity: 514,800 POUNDS

Location: CONUS

THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTE AND ONLY THE GOVERNMENT NOTICE OF IT'S INTENT IN THE NEAR FUTURE. 

When the solicitation is published on DIBBS, the requirement will be fully outlined in the solicitation.

All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal or quotation which shall be considered by the agency – REFERENCE – FAR 5.207 (c) (16).
